description.zh: 用户组与设备组同步关系控制ID。请传入调用[AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~)接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时，获取并保存到本地的**ControlId**参数值。
description.en: The control ID of the synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group. Set this parameter to the value of **ControlId** that you obtained and saved locally when you called the [AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~) operation to add the facial recognition synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group.

description.zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~)接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
description.en: The business isolation ID that isolates data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value of **IsolationId** that you specified when you called the [AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~) operation to add the facial recognition synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group.

title.zh: 删除用户组和设备组的人脸同步关系
title.en: Delete face sync relationship between user group and device group

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 100.
    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
